About us
JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company. As part of the JBS Australia Group, Andrews Meat Industries (AMI) provides vibrant long-term career prospects.

Andrews Meat Industries is a leading food service meat supplier comprising three key divisions: foodservice, value added (cooked) and export. Across these divisions, the company supplies to all areas of the hospitality industry, including restaurants, cafes, hotels, clubs, and resort groups, as well as servicing a number of other market segments, including health and aged care, education, aviation, and sporting venues.

About the Role
There is an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Lidcombe Site, this is a full-time role to provide data analysis, reporting and commercial support to the Commercial Business Units to facilitate informed decision-making and business performance improvement. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Key Responsibilities:
Generating and maintaining automation of Sales reports and functions (weekly, monthly, ad-hoc)
Help in Managing and maintaining Cost Prices and standard Prices
Assisting with ad-hoc data requests and projects as needed
Gathering data from various sources, cleaning, formatting, and preparing it for analysis. Retrieving data as requested by other team members or department
Ensuring the confidentiality and security of sensitive information
System Maintenance (Automated reports, ongoing auditing of data maintenance of program)
Updating internal and external pricing/costings
Problem solving – identifying and understanding the root cause, highlighting any risks, proposing solution, executing and/or escalating to Commercial Manager
Internal system maintenance including Inventory maintenance and creating codes for new product lines
Maintain and create effective and efficient work processes and procedures. Compile, file and complete client tender documentation
Analysing and interpreting sales, pricing and operational data to identify trends, patterns and business insights, and producing analytical reports and insights to support commercial decision-making
Collaborating with management and internal stakeholders to determine data requirements, reporting objectives and methodologies for data collection and analysis
Evaluating the accuracy, reliability and integrity of source data and implementing data validation procedures to maintain data quality standards
Performing data mining and data cleansing activities to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for process improvements and business optimisation
Developing and maintaining dashboards, charts and visualisations to communicate analytical findings and business insights to management and stakeholders
Applying data analytical tools and techniques to transform, process and interpret business data for reporting and decision-making purposes
Utilising reporting and database tools to automate data extraction, processing and visualisation activities
Preparing analytical reports, presentations and recommendations to support strategic planning and operational decision-making

About you:
Relevant Bachelor degree or higher qualification, plus at least 1 year of full-time experience in a similar role
Advanced Excel and reporting skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP and formulas)
Able to communicate and work with various stakeholders to understand data and support decision making
Strong data literacy
High attention to detail and accuracy
High organisational skills
Relevant experience within the manufacturing industry would be an advantage

The ad is valid for 28 days.

Interested? Please apply!

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

- Excellent benefits including salary packaging
- Fitzroy location

About the Role

You will work as part of the Biochemistry team to produce accurate, high quality and timely results and reports. You will be responsible for the efficient performance of routine testing and other duties that are assigned to you and will be directly responsible for the quality of the work performed.

Classifications for this position will range be Grade 1 from BU1-BU8 ($59,207 - $76,346 per annum pro rata)

Your Contribution 

Associate Diploma of Applied Science (Medical Laboratory) or equivalent.

Previous experience in a Diagnostic Clinical Biochemistry Laboratory

The ability to perform routine tests and maintenance of scientific instruments

Current National Criminal History check, or willing to obtain

What we Offer

A focus on wellbeing initiatives, with regular events and programs 

Confidential, solutions-focused employee counselling 

A healthy work-life balance encouraged. Full time employment comes with a monthly Accrued Day Off (additional day off per month!) 

Ability to join Fitness Passport - Your pass to an extensive choice of fitness facilities 

Salary Packaging - Increase your take home pay! 

In the heart of Fitzroy, CBD at our doorstep, close to some of Melbourne's best cafes, public transport and lots of carparks 

Discounts and Promotions always available through our Foundation 

Culture of continuous improvement 

About Biochemistry
The Clinical Biochemistry Department is a major section of St Vincent's Pathology, performing and supporting the results of specialist studies and analysis including molecular biology (PCR), protein electrophoresis, immunochemistry, specific IgE assays, chromatography, immunosuppressant monitoring, breath testing, autoimmune serology, blood gases and automated general biochemical analysis. The department is closely integrated with St Vincent's Pathology Point of Care Testing (POCT) services and is the pathology centre for co-ordination of Clinical Trials and Contract Testing. 

Working at St Vincent's 
St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne (SVHM) is a leading teaching, research and tertiary health service. SVHM provides a diverse range of adult clinical services and is driven by values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.

result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced Motor Mechanic to join Solution Dash Auto Care in Dandenong. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and reliable Vehicle Motor Mechanic to join our team. The role involves diagnosing, repairing, and servicing a wide range of vehicles, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Key tasks include conducting routine maintenance, identifying mechanical issues, using diagnostic equipment, and performing repairs in line with safety and manufacturer standards. The ideal candidate will have proven experience, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

Key Responsibilities:

- Inspecting vehicle engine and mechanical/electrical components to diagnose issues accurately
- Inspecting vehicle computer and electronic components to repair, maintain, and upgrade systems
- Conducting routine maintenance work such as replacing fluids, lubricating parts, and adjusting components aiming to vehicle functionality and longevity 
- Troubleshooting issues and fixing them aiming to maximum reliability and functionality
- Schedule future maintenance sessions and advise motorists about good vehicle usage
- Repair or replace broken of faulty parts and fix issues
- Provide accurate estimates (cost, time, effort) for a repair or maintenance job
- Keep work and issue logs
- Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition
- Perform routine automotive maintenance tasks, including fluid changes, tyre replacements, suspension/steering repairs, and OBD scanning
- Must be willing to upskill and keep working knowledge of current industry best practices in automotive repair
- Conduct extensive diagnostic procedures to determine the sources of customer problems and provide accurate repair recommendations
- Inspect vehicles according to the state's requirements for emissions and safety
- Conduct necessary repairs and take vehicles for test drives to verify soundness
- Maintain legible and accurate paperwork for both the customer and company records
- Clean and maintain the work environment to ensure equipment longevity and workplace safety

Performance Appraisal: Three months after the starting date, then half yearly or when required.

Qualification & Requirements:

- Provide Relevant Qualifications
- Effectively use hand tools and diagnostic equipment
- Able to handle hazardous materials safely and tolerate exposure to electrical hazards
- Able to perform heavy physical labour
- Great attentions to details
- No skin allergies or reactions to grease, oil or petrol
- Flexible hours available
- 1 year of relevant work experience required for this role
- RWC license not required but is an advantage

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super

Location: 4/9 Brooklyn Avenue, Dandenong 3175

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.

We’re looking for a skilled and experienced Systems Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for analysing, designing, and implementing effective information systems that support and streamline business operations. Your strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities will help drive efficiency and performance across our systems. The ideal candidate will bring at least 2 years of hands-on experience in systems analysis and a solid understanding of current technology trends.
Responsibilities:
Conducting requirement analysis and preparing specific proposals for modified or replacement systems
Ensuring that budgets are adhered to and deadlines met
Working closely with colleagues to provide IT solutions for internal and external clients
Providing training material and user manuals to users of new systems
Drawing up, supervising, and documenting testing schedules for complete systems
Planning and working flexibly to meet deadlines
Supporting users on change control and system updates
Meeting with multiple clients and key stakeholders
Creating project and costing reports
Developing financial project plans to support and lead the implementation of software solutions
Working with our clients to deploy system deliverables and train personnel across systems resources
Examining existing IT systems and business models
Analysing financial and marketing system requirements
Configuring automated processes using core workflow principles that are efficient, well-structured, maintainable, and easy to understand
Designing financial platforms and financial solutions
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a Systems Analyst, preferably in a technology-driven organisation
Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather and interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights and system requirements
Proficiency in system analysis methodologies, tools, and techniques, such as process modelling, data flow diagrams, and use case scenarios
Solid understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Familiarity with databases, SQL, and data integration principles
Excellent problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving system issues
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and present complex ideas clearly and concisely
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

Chef – Doreen VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters are working with a well-established and busy restaurant specialising in modern Australian cuisine located in Doreen VIC. The restaurant is known for its inviting atmosphere and offering delightful breakfast, brunch, and lunch options.
They are seeking a skilled and experienced Chef to join the leadership of the café's kitchen team. The ideal candidate will be a creative and dynamic professional who can support the day-to-day management of the cafe and lead food preparation.

•	Schedule - Includes weekday and weekend shifts

•	Tenure – full time, ongoing

•	Salary - Offered in the range of $80k to $85k plus superannuation per annum

•	Location - Doreen, VIC

If you’re a talented Chef ready to take on the challenge of leading a fast-paced kitchen and delivering exceptional dining experiences, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Responsibilities of our Chef will include:

•	Lead, mentor and inspire the kitchen team to deliver the best results.

•	Assist in the hiring and training of new cooks and kitchen staff.

•	Supervise (and participate in) the preparation of all meals.

•	Manage kitchen consumables, stock takes, ordering, cost control and budgeting.

•	In consultation with the Management team, develop, test, and introduce new menu items.

•	Ensure strict compliance with OH&S and Food Safety standards.

•	Work alongside the management team.

About you:

•	You have a passion for the hospitality industry and are up to date on techniques and food trends.

•	You can demonstrate an uncompromising attitude towards flavour and presentation of the highest quality, whilst aligning and motivating a cohesive and hardworking team environment.

•	Are empathetic to those around you and work well under pressure.

•	Have substantial experience working in a similar cuisine and professional environment.

To be successfully considered for the role, you:

•	Possess excellent relevant post-secondary cookery related qualifications, to at least Diploma level or agreed substitute.

•	Have at least three or more years’ experience since earning your qualifications, ideally in similar cuisine.

•	Are available across the working week and weekends.

•	Offer proven ability to prioritise, set goals and have the determination to achieve them.

•	Possess a thorough understanding of food safety and HACCP.

•	Understand cost control, time management, prioritization, and cost-efficient procurement practices.

•	Are an excellent people manager able to get the most out of your team.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Full time

Vacancy Listing Dates 09/07/2026 to 10/08/2026

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company and into Australia. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified:

•	Metal Fabricator
•	Welder 
•	Sheet Metal Trades Worker
•	Vehicle Body Builder
•	Fitter and Turner
•	Fitter-Welder
•	Pressure Welder 
•	Metal Machinist 
•	CNC Machinist

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Metal Fabricator
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in interpreting engineering drawings and blueprints, coupled with a solid understanding of metal properties and machinery. Your role will involve cutting, bending, and assembling metal structures and equipment through the use of welders, cutters, shapers, and measuring tools. You will be responsible for producing metal products according to clients specifications. Attention to detail, precision, and a safety-first attitude are paramount for success in this role.

Welder
Experienced and proficient Welder to become part of our welding department. This position demands proficiency in using various welding techniques (MIG, TIG, MMA) and equipment to join, surface, fabricate, and repair parts of metal or other weldable materials. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, with extensive knowledge of welding procedures and safety measures. You will work on a variety of projects, ensuring that final products meet the highest quality standards and are completed within the designated timeline.

Sheet Metal Trades Worker

We require Sheet Metal Trades Workers that can study blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job, material and equipment requirements. Select metal stock, such as stainless steel, galvanised iron, mild steel, aluminium and copper, and checking sizes, gauges and other dimensions of metal stock against specifications. Mark out metal stock with reference points and lines, using templates, gauges and other measuring instruments. Cut metal stock along guidelines using hand and power shears, guillotines and drills

Vehicle Body Builder

We are looking for Vehicle Body Builders that can manufacture and repair prototype production units and purpose-built vehicle bodies such as buses, trucks, fire engines and caravans. Constructing framework sections in metal wood fibreglass and other materials using shaping machines and cutting and welding equipment. Cutting and shaping panels of Sheetmetal aluminium and reinforced plastic and attaching to frameworks using hand and power tools

Fitter and Turner
Join our dynamic team as a Fitter and Turner, where you will be responsible for fabricating, fitting, and machining mechanical parts to assemble or repair mechanical systems. The role demands precision and attention to detail, with extensive knowledge of machine operation and material properties.

Fitter-Welder
We require a skilled Fitter-Welder to carry out both fitting tasks and welding operations according to project needs. Candidates should have proficiency in various welding techniques and the ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings. Experience in metal fabrication and a keen eye for quality are essential.

Pressure Welder
We are looking for a specialised Pressure Welder to support our operations with expertise in high-pressure vessels and piping . The role requires advanced knowledge and experience in welding processes that are crucial for the integrity of pressure vessels, boilers, and high-pressure piping systems. Candidates must possess the ability to read and interpret blueprints and standards related to pressure welding, ensuring compliance with both internal and external regulations and standards. This position demands high precision and adherence to strict safety and quality controls.

Metal Machinist
In this role, you will operate and maintain a variety of machines to produce precision parts and instruments. Key responsibilities include interpreting drawings, setting up mills and lathes, and conducting tests on completed tasks to ensure they meet specifications. The ideal candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of metal properties and machining techniques, combined with problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

CNC Machinist
This role involves programming, setting up, and operating CNC machines to produce high-quality parts and tools from metal, plastic, or other materials. The successful candidate will have in-depth knowledge of computer numerical control (CNC) machinery operations and processes, as well as an understanding of CAD/CAM software. Precision, attention to detail, and the ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and blueprints are essential. You will be instrumental in ensuring that our production goals are met with efficiency and high standards of quality.
